name: Merrell Moab 3 Waterproof Hiking Boot
description: The Merrell Moab 3 Waterproof is a legendary trail boot with Vibram outsole, M Select DRY waterproof membrane, and air cushion heel. Perfect for all-day comfort on rocky terrain.

name: Patagonia Footprint Waterproof Boot
description: Made with recycled materials and a GORE-TEX membrane, the Patagonia Footprint delivers waterproof protection with environmental responsibility. Features a Vibram Megagrip outsole and Fair Trade certified construction.

name: Salomon X Ultra 4 GTX
description: Salomon's X Ultra 4 GTX features GORE-TEX Extended Comfort waterproofing, Contagrip outsole, and Sensifit chassis for precision fit. Exceptional stability on technical trails.

name: Columbia Newton Ridge Waterproof Boot
description: Columbia's Newton Ridge offers waterproof construction with seam-sealed bootie and Techlite midsole. Budget-friendly trail boot with Omni-Grip rubber outsole for reliable traction.

name: Arc'teryx Acrux TR GTX
description: Premium Gore-Tex Pro waterproof hiking boot from Arc'teryx with Vibram Megagrip outsole. Built for technical mountain terrain with exceptional foot support and precision fit. Sustainably produced with recycled materials.

name: KEEN Targhee III Waterproof
description: KEEN's Targhee III uses 100% recycled lining and KEEN.DRY waterproof membrane. Wide toe box, metatomical footbed, and multi-directional outsole lugs. Certified KEEN.PROTECT with eco-conscious manufacturing.

name: La Sportiva Nucleo High GTX
description: Italian-crafted mountaineering boot with GORE-TEX waterproofing and Impact Brake System rubber outsole. Lightweight yet durable with a micro-injected rubber rand for edge control.

name: Patagonia Torrentshell 3L Rain Jacket
description: The Torrentshell 3L is Patagonia's most sustainable waterproof shell. Made from recycled nylon with bluesign-approved H2No Performance Standard. Fair Trade Certified. 100% waterproof, windproof, and breathable.

name: Arc'teryx Beta LT Jacket
description: Ultra-lightweight 3-layer GORE-TEX jacket engineered for alpine pursuits. Features StormHood and motion-capture patterning. Arc'teryx uses Bluesign certified fabrics and responsible down standard throughout.

name: Columbia Watertight II Rain Jacket
description: Columbia's Watertight II uses Omni-Tech waterproof breathable technology with fully seam-sealed construction. Packable design with hidden hood. Great value for casual hikers and day adventurers.

name: Black Diamond Distance Carbon Trekking Poles
description: Ultra-lightweight carbon fiber trekking poles with FlickLock Pro adjustability, padded grip, and flip-cap baskets. Designed for fast-packing and trail running. Responsibly manufactured with recycled packaging.

name: Osprey Trail Trekking Poles
description: Osprey's aluminum trekking poles with foam grip, dual-density wrist straps, and three-section adjustable shaft. EVA foam grip extension for variable terrain. Osprey uses responsible manufacturing practices.

name: Osprey Atmos AG 65 Backpack
description: Osprey's award-winning Anti-Gravity suspension system and breathable mesh trampoline back panel. 65L capacity with integrated rain cover, hipbelt pockets, and sleeping bag compartment. Lifetime guarantee.

name: Patagonia Black Hole 32L Backpack
description: Made from recycled polyester ripstop with weatherproof DWR finish. Patagonia's Black Hole packs are built tough with organization and the environment in mind. Bluesign approved fabrics.

name: Patagonia Capilene Cool Merino Base Layer
description: Patagonia's Capilene Cool Merino blends recycled polyester with Merino wool for moisture management and odor control. Fair Trade certified. 50% recycled content. Ideal base layer for active hiking.

name: Arc'teryx Rho LT Zip Neck Base Layer
description: Arc'teryx Phasic SL fabric wicks moisture while maintaining warmth. Flatlock seam construction for comfort under pack. Bluesign approved. Lightweight technical base for active pursuits.

name: Darn Tough Vermont Hiker Merino Wool Sock
description: Made in Vermont from 100% Merino wool with lifetime guarantee. Cushioned hiking sock with reinforced heel and toe. Naturally moisture-wicking and odor-resistant. No Chinese merino wool — all sourced responsibly.

name: Black Diamond Spot 400 Headlamp
description: 400 lumen headlamp with PowerTap Technology for quick brightness adjustments. Waterproof IPX8 rating. Dual fuel compatible (lithium or alkaline AAA). Ideal for night hikes and camping.

name: Hydro Flask 32oz Wide Mouth Trail Series
description: Professional grade stainless steel bottle with TempShield double-wall vacuum insulation. Keeps drinks cold 24h, hot 12h. Dishwasher safe. Made from 18/8 pro-grade stainless steel. Certified carbon neutral.

name: Merrell Trail Glove 7 Minimalist Shoe
description: Zero-drop minimalist trail shoe with Vibram TC5+ outsole and breathable mesh upper. Lightweight natural fit for experienced trail runners wanting ground feel. Made with recycled materials.
